parsed.why: Strongest legal framework of the five: notary marker change, trans/non-binary ID, court-protected facility access. But patterned lethal trans violence (40+ killed 2023, 13 in Q1 2025), armed-group kill lists naming trans, weak accountability, conflict-zone targeting.

Same-sex conduct criminalised with enforced convictions (2020 raid, 44 arrests); fact-check confirms ban on trans care and 'being transgender'; no recognition route, police complicity in vigilante killings, no gay venues, openly hostile society, no protections for LGBTQ detainees.

Trans people specifically criminalised via debauchery article (1 month–2 years plus fines) applied to gender nonconformity; Sharia death penalty on books, arrests continuing despite 2021 moratorium, official impunity, severe stigma. Worst combination of trans-specific statute plus state tolerance.

No criminalisation of conduct, no documented anti-trans violence, prosecutorial guidance treating GI hostility as aggravating. Offset by 2024 state drive to ban LGBTQIA+ advocacy, marriage redefinition, near-absent discrimination remedies and a conservative climate — official hostility framing, but not traveller-facing criminal exposure.

Hate-crime and anti-discrimination law naming gender identity, courts striking propaganda bans, police-protected Pride. But enforcement fails: confirmed service denial, commonplace discrimination, hate speech unaddressed, and documented 2025 institutional abuse of a trans detainee (isolation, strip searches, birth-sex treatment).
